brief: 5 data tools that turn raw events into shipped product insights.

slots.desc1: Open-source ELT that ingests events from any app or database.
slots.desc2: Transforms raw warehouse data into clean, tested analytics models.
slots.desc3: Product analytics with session replay, feature flags, and autocapture.
slots.desc4: Self-service BI dashboards that let anyone explore the data.
slots.desc5: Syncs warehouse insights back to your product and CRM tools.

slots.toolTagline: Open-source data movement for modern data teams.
slots.bigStatement: Ingest every click from your app into a warehouse in minutes, not weeks.
slots.use1Body: Extract user actions from APIs and databases with pre-built connectors.
slots.use2Body: Automatically handle breaking changes and normalized JSON payloads.
slots.use3Body: Self-host the platform or run managed syncs on your own cloud.

slots.toolTagline: The transformation layer that turns raw tables into analytics-ready models.
slots.bigStatement: Replace fragile SQL scripts with version-controlled, tested, and documented data pipelines.
slots.use1Body: Build reusable models that define users, sessions, and revenue metrics.
slots.use2Body: Add uniqueness and not-null tests to catch bad data before shipping.
slots.use3Body: Auto-generate a data dictionary that stays in sync with your code.

slots.toolTagline: Product analytics platform that captures events and visualizes user behavior.
slots.bigStatement: Autocapture every interaction so product teams ship features users actually want.
slots.use1Body: Track clicks, inputs, and pageviews without writing custom event instrumentation.
slots.use2Body: Roll out features to cohorts and measure impact with built-in experiments.
slots.use3Body: Watch real user sessions to find friction points in the funnel.

slots.toolTagline: The easiest way for teams to share data and discover insights.
slots.bigStatement: Let non-technical teams self-serve answers without writing a single SQL query.
slots.use1Body: Build questions with filters, joins, and aggregations through a visual editor.
slots.use2Body: Combine charts into auto-refreshing dashboards synced to the warehouse.
slots.use3Body: Get Slack or email alerts when metrics spike or drop unexpectedly.

slots.toolTagline: Reverse ETL that syncs warehouse data to the tools your team uses.
slots.bigStatement: Turn SQL queries into live segments inside your CRM, ads, and product stack.
slots.use1Body: Push high-intent user lists from the warehouse to marketing platforms automatically.
slots.use2Body: Enrich in-app experiences with computed traits stored in your data warehouse.
slots.use3Body: Write a query once and map columns to any destination field instantly.

slots.toolTagline: Version-controlled pipelines that ship insights from pull request to production.
slots.bigStatement: Deploy dbt models and dashboards with CI tests so bad data never ships.
slots.use1Body: Run transformations on git branches before merging to the main warehouse.
slots.use2Body: Peer-review SQL changes, metric definitions, and schema updates like software.
slots.use3Body: Revert any broken pipeline state to a previous commit in seconds.

slots.body: Start with Airbyte and dbt, then add activation with Hightouch. No complex setup required.
